files.content:
ttl: 30
loop_wait: 10
retry_timeout: 10
maximum_lag_on_failover: 1048576
failsafe_mode: true
postgresql:
  use_pg_rewind: true
  use_slots: true
  parameters:
    compute_query_id: 'auto'
    hot_standby: 'on'
    max_replication_slots: '20'
    max_wal_senders: '20'
    password_encryption: 'scram-sha-256'
    pg_stat_statements.track: 'top'
    shared_preload_libraries: 'pg_stat_statements'
    wal_keep_size: '1GB'
    wal_level: 'logical'
    wal_log_hints: 'on'

ETCD_NAME=10.0.0.2
ETCD_DATA_DIR=/srv/postgres/etcd
ETCD_LISTEN_CLIENT_URLS=http://10.0.0.2:2379,http://127.0.0.1:2379
ETCD_ADVERTISE_CLIENT_URLS=http://10.0.0.2:2379
ETCD_LISTEN_PEER_URLS=http://10.0.0.2:2380
ETCD_INITIAL_ADVERTISE_PEER_URLS=http://10.0.0.2:2380
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER=10.0.0.1=http://10.0.0.1:2380,10.0.0.2=http://10.0.0.2:2380
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_TOKEN=databasify-db-1
ETCD_MAX_LEARNERS=7
ETCD_AUTO_COMPACTION_MODE=periodic
ETCD_AUTO_COMPACTION_RETENTION=1h
ETCD_QUOTA_BACKEND_BYTES=2147483648

scope: 'main'
name: '10.0.0.2'
restapi:
  listen: '0.0.0.0:8008'
  connect_address: '10.0.0.2:8008'
  authentication:
    username: patroni
    password: 'ag$ent'
etcd3:
  hosts: '10.0.0.1:2379,10.0.0.2:2379,10.0.0.3:2379,10.0.0.4:2379'
bootstrap:
  dcs:
    ttl: 30
    loop_wait: 10
    retry_timeout: 10
    maximum_lag_on_failover: 1048576
    failsafe_mode: true
    postgresql:
      use_pg_rewind: true
      use_slots: true
      parameters:
        compute_query_id: 'auto'
        hot_standby: 'on'
        max_replication_slots: '20'
        max_wal_senders: '20'
        password_encryption: 'scram-sha-256'
        pg_stat_statements.track: 'top'
        shared_preload_libraries: 'pg_stat_statements'
        wal_keep_size: '1GB'
        wal_level: 'logical'
        wal_log_hints: 'on'
  initdb:
    - encoding: UTF8
    - data-checksums
postgresql:
  listen: '*:25060'
  connect_address: '10.0.0.2:25060'
  data_dir: '/srv/postgres/data'
  bin_dir: '/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin'
  pgpass: '/srv/postgres/conf/pgpass'
  use_unix_socket: true
  use_unix_socket_repl: false
  remove_data_directory_on_rewind_failure: true
  remove_data_directory_on_diverged_timelines: true
  authentication:
    superuser:
      username: postgres
      password: 'adm''in'
    replication:
      username: replicator
      password: 'rep"l'
    rewind:
      username: postgres
      password: 'adm''in'
  parameters:
    archive_command: 'pgbackrest --config=/srv/postgres/conf/pgbackrest.conf --stanza=main archive-push %p'
    archive_mode: 'on'
    archive_timeout: '60'
    log_destination: 'stderr'
    logging_collector: 'off'
    ssl: 'on'
    ssl_cert_file: '/srv/postgres/tls/server.crt'
    ssl_key_file: '/srv/postgres/tls/server.key'
    ssl_min_protocol_version: 'TLSv1.2'
    statement_timeout: '5000'
    unix_socket_directories: '/srv/postgres/run'
  pg_hba:
    - 'local all postgres peer'
    - 'local all all scram-sha-256'
    - 'host all all 127.0.0.1/32 scram-sha-256'
    - 'host all all ::1/128 scram-sha-256'
    - 'host replication replicator 127.0.0.1/32 scram-sha-256'
    - 'host replication replicator ::1/128 scram-sha-256'
    - 'hostssl replication replicator 0.0.0.0/0 scram-sha-256'
    - 'hostssl all all 0.0.0.0/0 scram-sha-256'
tags:
  nofailover: false
  noloadbalance: false
  nosync: false
  clonefrom: false

[global]
repo1-type=s3
repo1-storage-port=9000
repo1-s3-endpoint=s3.example.com
repo1-s3-bucket=bk
repo1-s3-region=us-east-1
repo1-s3-key=AK
repo1-s3-key-secret=S'K
repo1-s3-uri-style=path
repo1-path=/db/x
repo1-retention-full-type=time
repo1-retention-full=7
repo1-bundle=y
compress-type=zst
process-max=2
start-fast=y
archive-async=y
archive-push-queue-max=4GiB
spool-path=/srv/postgres/archive/spool
lock-path=/srv/postgres/archive/lock
log-path=/srv/postgres/archive/log
log-level-console=warn
log-level-file=info

[main]
pg1-path=/srv/postgres/data
pg1-port=25060
pg1-socket-path=/srv/postgres/run

[databases]
postgres = host=127.0.0.1 port=25060 dbname=postgres pool_size=2
%include /srv/postgres/conf/pgbouncer-pools.ini

[pgbouncer]
listen_addr = *
listen_port = 25061
unix_socket_dir =
auth_type = scram-sha-256
auth_file = /srv/postgres/conf/pgbouncer-users.txt
auth_user = pgbouncer
auth_dbname = postgres
auth_query = SELECT username, password FROM pgbouncer.get_auth($1)
client_tls_sslmode = require
client_tls_cert_file = /srv/postgres/tls/server.crt
client_tls_key_file = /srv/postgres/tls/server.key
server_tls_sslmode = require
max_client_conn = 5000
default_pool_size = 16
ignore_startup_parameters = extra_float_digits,options

manifest:
{
  "processes": [
    {
      "name": "databasify-postgres-locks",
      "type": "oneshot",
      "user": "postgres",
      "argv": [
        "sh",
        "-c",
        "pgrep -x postgres \u003e /dev/null || rm -f /srv/postgres/run/.s.PGSQL.* /srv/postgres/data/postmaster.pid"
      ],
      "enabled": true
    },
    {
      "name": "databasify-etcd",
      "user": "postgres",
      "restart": "always",
      "restartSec": "3s",
      "argv": [
        "sh",
        "-c",
        "set -a; . /srv/postgres/conf/etcd.env; for extra in /srv/postgres/conf/etcd-initial.env /srv/postgres/conf/etcd-force.env; do [ ! -f \"$extra\" ] || . \"$extra\"; done; set +a\npeers() { awk -F \"'\" '/^  hosts: / { print $2 }' /srv/postgres/conf/patroni.yml 2\u003e/dev/null | tr ',' '\\n' | grep -v \"^$ETCD_NAME:\"; }\nif [ \"$ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE\" = new ] \u0026\u0026 [ ! -d \"$ETCD_DATA_DIR/member\" ]; then\n    for endpoint in $(peers); do\n        if timeout 10 etcdctl --endpoints=\"http://$endpoint\" member list 2\u003e/dev/null | awk -F ', ' -v peer=\"$ETCD_INITIAL_ADVERTISE_PEER_URLS\" '$4 == peer { listed = 1 } END { exit !listed }'; then\n            echo \"etcd on $ETCD_NAME lost its data while http://$endpoint still lists it, waiting until it is registered again\"\n            exit 1\n        fi\n    done\nfi\nif [ \"$ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE\" = existing ] \u0026\u0026 [ ! -d \"$ETCD_DATA_DIR/member\" ]; then\n    for endpoint in $(peers); do\n        cluster=$(timeout 10 etcdctl --endpoints=\"http://$endpoint\" member list 2\u003e/dev/null | awk -F ', ' -v peer=\"$ETCD_INITIAL_ADVERTISE_PEER_URLS\" -v self=\"$ETCD_NAME\" '{ name = ($4 == peer) ? self : $3; printf \"%s%s=%s\", separator, name, $4; separator = \",\" }')\n        if [ -n \"$cluster\" ]; then\n            export ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER=\"$cluster\"\n            break\n        fi\n    done\nfi\nexec /usr/local/bin/etcd"
      ],
      "enabled": false
    },
    {
      "name": "databasify-patroni",
      "user": "postgres",
      "after": [
        "databasify-postgres-locks",
        "databasify-etcd"
      ],
      "restart": "always",
      "restartSec": "3s",
      "stopSignal": "SIGTERM",
      "stopTimeout": "2m",
      "argv": [
        "/usr/bin/patroni",
        "/srv/postgres/conf/patroni.yml"
      ],
      "enabled": false
    },
    {
      "name": "databasify-pgbouncer",
      "user": "postgres",
      "after": [
        "databasify-postgres",
        "databasify-patroni"
      ],
      "restart": "always",
      "restartSec": "3s",
      "argv": [
        "/usr/sbin/pgbouncer",
        "/srv/postgres/conf/pgbouncer.ini"
      ],
      "enabled": false
    }
  ],
  "schedules": [
    {
      "name": "databasify-postgres-backup",
      "onCalendar": "03:00",
      "timeout": "24h",
      "argv": [
        "/usr/local/bin/databasify",
        "engine-task",
        "backup"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
